title: [Master] - Bug 644751 Moving an expense report line to another report wrongly reports a duplicate
summary: Fixed incorrect duplicate detection when moving an expense report line between open reports by excluding the source line from the validation check.
key_points: Duplicate validation now excludes the originating line when a line is moved to another report
Prevents false duplicate warnings when relocating expense report lines
True duplicates within or across reports are still detected correctly
Updated tests to cover the move scenario
